## Change

What problem does this solve, and what can a user or another contributor do now?

## Evidence

Commands, scenes and results. For a solver/performance change, compare quality **and** full-step cost on the same inputs; use [the benchmark contract](https://github.com/erythrofr/ClothCraft/blob/main/docs/solver-challenge.md). State whether GPU runs were performed.

## Limits

Unsupported cases, remaining risks and next useful experiment. Include sources/provenance for new algorithms, external code or fixtures.
